South African lawmakers propose draft rules on cross-border crypto transactions
items.summary: A draft rulebook proposes that sending crypto offshore must be conducted through an authorized provider and be reported to the central bank’s FinSurv.

items.title: Bitcoin rises toward $64,000 as Coldcard exploit, Strategy sales recede. ADA advances
items.summary: Bitcoin advanced as the market settled down following the weekend’s hack of Coldcard wallets and sales by Strategy even as sentiment remained in “extreme fear.”

items.title: BlackRock debuts tokenized access to $311 billion of money market funds in Europe
